title: System Simplification
hook: I built a system so complicated even I stopped using it.
statement: The simpler the system, the more it actually gets done.
explainer: A clever system you skip loses to a simple one you run daily.
sop: Write out every step, even tiny ones.
Cut what doesn't serve the outcome.
equation_example: Simplicity 8 × Consistency 9 = 72. Easy to run, and it actually gets run.
question: Pick one process. Write what you'd cut in half.
closing_statement: Too complex to follow means never followed.
